details:
VESTIGE: Interplanetary Relic Atlas is a bilingual (English and Arabic) interactive web atlas of the spacecraft humanity has left on the Moon and Mars. It treats each lander, rover and orbiter as a heritage site, an “archaeology of the space age.”

How it works: Users choose a world and explore a Leaflet map built on NASA Trek tiles, a mission timeline, detailed mission dossiers, spacecraft schematics, last-signal telemetry and an Earth-to-space signal-delay explainer. A signal-tuning game and a quiz make learning interactive.

Benefits and impact: It makes scattered space-heritage data engaging for students and curious readers. It gives Arabic speakers a full native experience, including right-to-left layout. It encourages thinking about humanity’s lasting footprint beyond Earth.

Tools: TypeScript, React 18, Vite, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Leaflet, Motion and the Web Audio API. It runs in any modern browser.

Creativity: Missions are presented as relics, with a dark observatory look and last-signal storytelling. Sound is synthesized in the browser, and Arabic is built in from the start.

Factors considered: accessibility and localization, accurate NASA/USGS attribution, fallback map tiles, performance through code-splitting and cleanup, and SEO through prerendering.
